data.name: Brain Bistro
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Brain Bistro is a relaxing simulation game that combines restaurant management, guest stories, and brain-teasing mini-games.

Choose a city from the world map and open a small restaurant of your own. Guests will arrive throughout the day, bringing different challenges during ordering, cooking, and checkout. Observation, memory, calculation, reaction, logic, sound, and spatial reasoning—every table may test a different skill.

Run a Restaurant and Train Your Mind

Brain Bistro features a wide variety of brain games, with the pace gradually adjusting to your progress and performance. You may need to memorize menus, control the heat, make change, identify guests, organize shelves, recognize sequences, or manage several tasks at once.

The better you perform, the happier your guests will be. A mistake does not end your journey—the restaurant keeps running, and the next table offers another chance to find your rhythm.

Build a Restaurant of Your Own

Begin with a simple little shop and gradually improve its tables, seating, lighting, walls, flooring, and decorations. Create a homey, elegant, or lively atmosphere, adjust your service menu, manage ingredients, and hire staff to help with serving, accounting, and cooking.

Each business day moves through early morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner, and closing time. Guest traffic, orders, and special events change throughout the day, giving every shift its own rhythm.

Meet the Guests Who Walk Through Your Door

Guests are more than numbers waiting to pay. They have different personalities, preferences, levels of patience, and ways of visiting your restaurant. As familiar faces return, some may become valued regulars—or even close friends.

Dine-in guests, takeout orders, special visitors, and unexpected events keep the restaurant feeling alive. Use the in-game phone to check regulars, recipes, collections, business records, and news from around the world.

Take Your Business Around the World

Learn local specialties from different cities and open branches across the globe. Visit your branches, develop signature dishes, seize seasonal opportunities, and plan around changing markets, news, airfares, exchange rates, and natural events.

As your business expands, you will encounter management routes, regional operations, and larger special banquets. Every decision adds another chapter to the story of your restaurant.

Features

  • Restaurant management combined with brain-training mini-games

  • Challenges involving memory, logic, calculation, reaction, observation, sound, and more

  • A complete management system covering location, decor, menus, ingredients, and staff training

  • A living flow of guests with different personalities and preferences

  • Regular relationships, recipe collections, achievements, and restaurant chronicles

  • Cities, local dishes, branches, and regional management around the world

Open the doors, serve every dish, and take on every challenge your guests bring.

Keep your mind sharp, make each day count, and grow one small restaurant into a business that reaches the world.

data.short_description: Brain Bistro blends cozy management with quick brain games. Choose a city, serve quirky guests, and solve puzzles while taking orders, cooking, and settling bills. Decorate your shop, train staff, meet regulars, learn world dishes, open branches, and grow your one-of-a-kind bistro.
